title: Apache nifi: It is possible for outbound HTTP requests using a Micrometer-instrumented client to cause a…
description: A vulnerability in Apache NiFi versions prior to 2.13.0-r0 allows outbound HTTP requests using a Micrometer-instrumented client to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition due to an unbounded memory leak. This issue has been assigned CVE-2026-59295 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability. A fix is available in version 2.13.0-r0.
